scope: Read-only code review and bounded direct Python probes. The production Python runner used an independent CCW bridge substitute. This is not a new Racket authority check, a full battery, or training approval.

resolved_findings.proof_scope: For successful default draws, the first four raw indices contain two extended examples. Consecutive extended examples have different minimum-dimension parity and therefore different shapes; canonical examples have disjoint 3x3 dimensions. Removing repeated canonical examples cannot remove either extended witness. Every accepted four-pair lesson therefore retains at least two extended witnesses under content deduplication.

review_assessment: No remaining critical or important issue found in the reviewed generator and focused contract tests, within the stated finite-rival/default-generation scope.
remaining_limits: Informational rejection intentionally applies only when effective overrides are empty; an explicit no-op override also exits that guarantee.
self_check intentionally retains at least two realized colors, while the underlying rotation operation is defined for monochrome grids too.
The new foreground rivals are input-only, deterministic hypotheses. Refuting the 11 declared rivals is not a uniqueness or universal-induction claim.
The minimum-dimension argument assumes successful valid draws; the finite rejection loop can still report failure rather than promise generation for every possible seed.
Single-component extended examples remain legal to the validator and through controls, but the default extended teaching distribution is conditioned to distinguish whole-foreground processing.
